title: heliotropium ternatum var. fumana
intro: Heliotropium ternatum var. fumana, commonly known as Fumana or Rock Rose, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the borage family. The health benefits of Fumana include its potential to soothe and calm the nervous system, acting as an anxiolytic and anti-inflammatory agent. Fumana's therapeutic actions include its use in treating anxiety disorders, insomnia, and inflammation-related conditions. The bioactive constituents of Fumana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
